root_cause.text: nci_close_device() holds req_lock while flushing rx_wq, but nci_rx_work() running on rx_wq can acquire req_lock via a call chain through socket destruct and nfc_deactivate_target, creating a circular locking dependency.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the flush_workqueue(ndev->rx_wq) from inside the req_lock-protected region (line 579-580 removed) to after mutex_unlock(&ndev->req_lock) (line 615 added). The commit message explicitly describes the deadlock chain: nci_rx_work -> ... -> nci_request -> mutex_lock(&ndev->req_lock).

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove flush of RX workqueue in nci_close_device to avoid potential deadlock, as flushing under the lock is unsafe.
intent_record.what: Removed the line `flush_workqueue(ndev->rx_wq);` and updated the comment from 'Flush RX and TX wq' to 'Flush TX wq, RX wq flush can't be under the lock'.
intent_record.how: The function no longer flushes the RX workqueue, preventing a potential deadlock that could occur if the RX workqueue was flushed while holding a lock (as indicated by the comment). Only the TX workqueue is flushed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Update comments in nci_close_device to improve accuracy regarding work queue state and flush purpose.
intent_record.what: Updated two comments in nci_close_device: the first comment now notes that rx work may still be running after queues are empty; the second comment now explicitly mentions flushing both cmd and tx work queues.
intent_record.how: No functional change; only comments are modified to better describe the current behavior and intent of the code.

intent_record.intent_summary: Flush the receive workqueue after releasing req_lock to ensure all pending rx work completes before device close finishes, preventing race conditions.
intent_record.what: Added a call to flush_workqueue(ndev->rx_wq) after mutex_unlock in nci_close_device, along with a comment explaining that rx_work may take req_lock via nci_deactivate_target.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that any pending work items in the receive workqueue are completed before the function returns, preventing potential race conditions during device closure by waiting for rx work that might acquire the req_lock.

bic_trace_step.reason: In nci_close_device (line ~295), after mutex_lock(&ndev->req_lock), it calls flush_workqueue(ndev->rx_wq) which waits for nci_rx_work to complete. nci_rx_work (line ~509) processes packets, and a notification could lead to nci_deactivate_target (line ~426), which calls nci_request, which tries to acquire mutex_lock(&ndev->req_lock). This creates a circular locking dependency. No fix is present in this initial commit.
